title: Chapter 78 Buying Tung Oil
content:
Chapter 78 Buying Tung Oil

You should know that he now has more than 40,000 energy crystals, as well as skills, soul crystals and other valuable things.

Just as Wang Shuo was thinking about how he got on the list, people around him began to whisper.

"This Ni Wu is said to be from the outside world. He is level 30 when he first arrived. This ranking is not fair to us novice players."

"You better keep your voice down. If the people from the Iron Sword Gate hear you, be careful to peel your skin."

"Shh, I heard that Ni Wu is a man who kills without blinking an eye and is completely unreasonable."

"Look, the Wild Wolf Gang is on the list. I heard that their leader Zhuge Kewei is already level 21, and he has issued a gang-building order, officially establishing the Wild Wolf Gang."

"What's so great about that? If we have a gang-building order, we will definitely be on the list."

"Come on, you, the Flame Rose, a bunch of little girls, how can you compare with others."

"What did you say?" Ou Fulan heard someone slandering the Flame Rose, and immediately scolded that person.

Seeing that the person who spoke was Ou Fulan, the middle-aged man who had been talking loudly just now was immediately scared: "So it turns out that you are one of the five golden flowers of the Flame Rose. I was rude just now. I hope that the lady will not bear grudges and forgive me this time!"

"Get lost! Don't let me see you again!"

Yue Ji looked at the list and murmured: "I didn't expect that Wang Shuo would be so powerful!"

In Nanshanji, the strength of the Flame Rose is second only to the Wild Wolf Gang. There is no room for two tigers in one mountain. There is a high possibility that conflicts will break out in the future. She must find someone to form an alliance.

She regretted her reckless behavior just now.

Suddenly, the system announcement sounded again.

[Please note that all lord players: After 1 day, wild monsters will begin to invade the village. 】

After hearing the system announcement, Wang Shuo quickly opened the [Task] column.

Side quests:

1. Wild monster invasion: Wild beasts in the wild will clear the villages within their sphere of influence under the leadership of the group leader. Please be prepared to resist.

There was only this one side quest left. The previous town search quest had been completed and disappeared.

Wang Shuo curled his lips and complained, "The quest was completed, but there was no reward."

After thinking for a while, Wang Shuo immediately decided to go to the system shop first to buy supplies, and then hurried back to his Wana Village.

After walking hundreds of meters along the street, Wang Shuo finally found the system shop that Li Youcai mentioned.

The shop occupies a larger area than Li's grocery store, and the four words "System Shop" were written in large gilded characters on the plaque.

Entering the hall, Wang Shuo found that there were no containers, only a few NPCs standing there.

There were also few players entering, which seemed a bit deserted.

Wang Shuo walked over and asked.

"Do you have tung oil for sale here?" Wang Shuo asked an NPC.

This was one of the supplies that Wang Shuo and Chang Gui decided to buy after discussing.

"Of course, I wonder how much you want to buy?" The NPC clerk asked mechanically.

At this time, an electronic display suddenly appeared in front of Wang Shuo.

The price of one unit of tung oil is 10 silver coins, which is 2 silver coins higher than the price in Li Youcai's shop.

When doing business in Nanshan Market, the selling price in the shops is basically lower than that in the system shops, and the purchase price is higher.

The system shop is like a price management bureau, which invisibly controls the prices of goods in the market.

Wang Shuo directly bought 10,000 units. The beasts besieged Wana Village, and the amount of tung oil used must be as much as possible.

Wang Shuo checked other items again. The price of the system weapon was 100,000 gold coins, which made Wang Shuo give up directly. It is more cost-effective to go to Zhao Bangde to brush military merit points.
